{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Compute total number of patients
total_patients = len(df)
print(f"total_patients = {total_patients}")

# Compute number of patients with 'severe' severity
severe_patients = df[df['severity'] == 'severe'].shape[0]
print(f"severe_patients = {severe_patients}")

# Compute fraction
fraction_severe = severe_patients / total_patients
print(f"fraction_severe = {fraction_severe}")

# Round to 3 decimal places for reporting
rounded_fraction = round(fraction_severe, 3)
print(f"rounded_fraction = {rounded_fraction}")"}
